no_adcom_quote.quote: The application for Zydelig was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant public health questions.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 205858 (Zydelig/idelalisib). The Office Director memo and cross-discipline team leader review state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions, and the medical review confirms the application was not discussed by the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
